steps: Combine 1 cup lactose-free plain yogurt, 1 banana, 1/2 cup blueberries, and 1 cup spinach in a blender.
Blend until smooth.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
Pour 250 g coconut yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 50 g certified gluten-free seed-based granola, 120 g diced mango, and 1 tbsp chia seeds.
Cook 80 g dry quinoa in water or milk according to package directions until fluffy, about 10 minutes.
Transfer cooked quinoa to a bowl and top with 1 sliced banana, 80 g mixed berries, and 1 tbsp maple syrup.
Cook 80 g dry buckwheat groats in water or milk for 12 minutes until tender.
Transfer to a bowl and top with 80 g mixed berries and 1 tbsp honey.
Heat 200 g white rice porridge (congee) in a pot until steaming.
Pour into a bowl, top with 100 g cubed firm tofu, 1 sliced scallion, and 1 tsp tamari.
Place 1/2 cup roasted chickpeas in a bowl.
Add 4 dried apricots.
Arrange 40 g beef jerky on a plate.
Serve alongside 1/4 cup dried fruit mix.
Microwave 300 g sweet potato for 5–8 minutes until tender, then split it open.
Spread 1.5 tbsp almond butter inside the hot sweet potato, sprinkle with 1/2 tsp cinnamon, and serve with 1 banana on the side.
Microwave 300 g sweet potato for 5–8 minutes until tender, then split it open.
Spread 1.5 tbsp sunflower seed butter inside the hot sweet potato and serve with 1 banana on the side.
Slice 1 apple or banana and arrange on a plate.
Serve with 1.5 tbsp sunflower seed butter for dipping.
Microwave 200 g sweet potato for 5–8 minutes until tender.
Cook 4 egg whites by poaching, frying, or boiling until done.
Plate the sweet potato, top with the cooked egg whites, and drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil.
Arrange 100 g sliced turkey breast on a plate.
Add 1 halved avocado and 2 cups baby spinach.
Cook 3 bacon rashers in a skillet over medium-high heat until crispy.
Arrange bacon, 1/2 avocado sliced, and 1 sliced tomato on a plate.
Place 200 g cottage cheese in a bowl.
Top with 150 g pineapple chunks and serve with 150 ml 100% fruit juice on the side.
Combine 1/4 cup pumpkin & sunflower seeds with 1/4 cup dried fruit in a bowl.
Add 1/2 cup certified gluten-free breakfast cereal and stir together.
Boil 2 eggs for 12 minutes until hard-boiled, then peel and arrange on a plate.
Serve with 2 gluten-free fig bars and 1 cup grapes.
Heat 300 g ugali (maize porridge) in a pot until warm.
Warm 100 g managu (African nightshade greens) gently in a separate pot.
Plate the ugali, top with warmed managu, and serve with 250 ml hot chai (milk tea).
Boil 1 egg for 10 minutes until cooked through.
Heat 2 pieces mandazi (fried dough) in a skillet or microwave.
Plate the mandazi, peel and add the boiled egg, peel and add 1 medium banana, and serve with 250 ml hot chai (milk tea).
Toast 4 slices white bread until golden.
Prepare 2–3 cups hot chai (milk tea) and serve alongside the toast.
Heat 1 bowl of maize or millet porridge in a pot until warm.
Toast 1–2 slices bread.
Plate the porridge and toast, peel and slice 1 banana or orange, and serve with 1 cup hot chai (milk tea).
Warm 2 pieces chapati (wheat flatbread) in a dry skillet over medium heat until soft.
Serve with 1 cup hot chai (milk tea).
Heat 250 g ugali (maize porridge) and 100 g beans together in a pot until warm.
Serve with 250 ml mursik (fermented milk).
Boil 200 g sweet potato until tender, about 10 minutes, then peel and slice.
Plate the sweet potato, peel and add 1 banana, and serve with 1 cup hot chai (milk tea).
Heat 300 g genfo (roasted barley/wheat porridge) with water or milk until warmed through and porridge consistency.
Top with 1 tbsp niter kibbeh (spiced butter) stirred into the hot porridge, then sprinkle 1 tsp berbere spice on top.
Scramble 2 eggs in a hot skillet until just cooked through.
Tear 150 g injera (teff flatbread) into bite-sized pieces and place in a bowl.
Top the injera with the scrambled eggs and drizzle with 1 tsp berbere-spiced oil.
Heat 250 g teff porridge in a pot until warm.
Transfer to a bowl and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Toast 2 slices white bread.
Boil 1 egg for 10 minutes until hard-boiled, then peel.
Plate the toast and egg, and serve with 1 cup hot chai (milk tea).
Boil 1 egg for 10 minutes until hard-boiled, then peel and place on a plate.
Peel and add 1 banana, and serve with 1 cup hot chai (milk tea).
Arrange 200 g steamed rice in a bowl and pour 200 ml hot miso soup over it.
Top with 50 g natto and 1 raw egg, then stir to combine.
Pour 200 g steamed rice into a bowl and top with 50 g natto.
Add 1 tsp soy sauce and 1 tbsp chopped scallions, then stir to combine.
Arrange 200 g steamed rice on a plate.
Add 100 g grilled salmon and 50 g tsukemono (pickled vegetables).
Prepare 1 onsen tamago (soft-cooked egg) by poaching in 65–70°C water for 6 minutes.
Arrange 200 g steamed rice in a bowl, top with the soft egg and 50 g natto, and stir gently to combine.
Arrange 200 g steamed rice in a bowl.
Tear 1 nori sheet, place on top, and center 1 umeboshi (pickled plum) in the bowl.
Heat 300 g okayu (rice porridge) in a pot until warm.
Transfer to a bowl and top with 1 raw or soft-cooked egg stirred through.
Arrange 200 g steamed rice in a bowl.
Top with 80 g himono (dried grilled fish) and serve with 200 ml hot miso soup on the side.
Pour 200 g steamed rice into a bowl and crack 1 raw egg over the top.
Drizzle with 1 tsp soy sauce and stir until the egg is evenly distributed.
Arrange 200 g steamed rice in a bowl.
Top with 50 g natto, 50 g kimchi, and 30 g pickles, then stir gently to combine.
Warm 1 arepa (corn cake) in a skillet.
Scramble 2 eggs in a separate skillet until cooked through.
Plate the arepa, top with scrambled eggs, and sprinkle 30 g queso fresco over.
Heat 100 g white rice and 100 g beans together in a pot.
Fry 1 egg in a skillet.
Warm 1 arepa in a skillet.
Plate together: rice-and-beans, fried egg, arepa, and 50 g sliced avocado.
Heat 100 g white rice and 100 g beans together in a pot.
Fry 80 g chorizo in a skillet.
Warm 1 arepa in a skillet.
Plate together: rice-and-beans, chorizo, and arepa.
Fry 100 g patacones (fried green plantain) in a skillet.
Fry 1 egg in a separate skillet.
Plate the patacones, top with the fried egg, and sprinkle 30 g queso fresco over.
Warm 2 corn tortillas in a dry skillet.
Heat 100 g refried beans in a pot.
Scramble 2 eggs in a skillet.
Assemble: spread beans on tortillas, top with eggs, and add 50 g sliced avocado.
Warm 1 arepa in a skillet until soft.
Split it open and spread 1 tsp butter inside.
Top with 30 g queso fresco.
Arrange 1 pan de bono (cheese bread) on a plate.
Serve with 1 cup hot tinto (black coffee).
Fry 100 g sweet plantain slices in a skillet until caramelized.
Heat 100 g black beans in a pot.
Fry 1 egg in a skillet.
Plate together: fried plantain, black beans, and fried egg.
Warm 1 flour tortilla in a dry skillet.
Heat 80 g refried beans.
Assemble: spread beans on tortilla and add 50 g sliced avocado.
Arrange 100 g labneh and 1 pita bread on a plate.
Add 50 g sliced cucumber and 50 g sliced tomato.
Spread 100 g labneh on a plate and drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Sprinkle with 1 tsp za'atar and serve with 1 pita bread.
Arrange 40 g feta cheese, 30 g olives, 50 g sliced cucumber, and 50 g sliced tomato on a plate.
Add 1 boiled egg (peeled) and 1 slice bread.
Poach 2 eggs in simmering water until set, about 3 minutes.
Mix 100 g yogurt with 1 minced garlic clove and spread on a plate.
Top the garlicky yogurt with the poached eggs, drizzle with 1 tsp chili butter, and serve with 1 slice bread.
Arrange 100 g hummus and 1 pita bread on a plate.
Add 50 g sliced cucumber and 50 g sliced tomato.
Spread 100 g labneh on a plate and drizzle with 1 tbsp honey.
Top with 20 g walnuts and serve with 1 pita bread.
Fry 60 g halloumi in a skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.
Arrange on a plate with 50 g sliced cucumber, 50 g sliced tomato, and 1 pita bread.
Arrange 40 g beyaz peynir (white cheese), 30 g olives, 50 g sliced cucumber, and 50 g sliced tomato on a plate.
Add 1 simit (sesame bread ring).
Spread 60 g labneh on 1/2 pita bread.
Top with 30 g sliced cucumber and roll closed.
Place 1 slice rye bread on a plate.
Top with 150 g skyr and 80 g mixed berries.
Mix together 60 g rye flakes, 150 ml milk, and 100 g skyr in a bowl.
Top with 80 g mixed berries and 1 tbsp mixed seeds, refrigerate overnight before serving.
Arrange 2 pieces rye crispbread on a plate.
Top each with 15 g cheese and 25 g sliced cucumber.
Pour 200 g skyr into a bowl.
Top with 40 g granola and 80 g mixed berries.
Arrange 1 slice rye bread on a plate.
Top with 60 g smoked salmon and 1 boiled egg (peeled and halved).
Pour 200 ml filmjölk (cultured milk) into a bowl.
Top with 50 g muesli and 80 g mixed berries.
Mix 50 g rolled oats and 150 g skyr together in a bowl.
Top with 1 tbsp lingonberry jam.
Arrange 4 idli on a plate.
Serve with 150 ml hot sambar (lentil-vegetable stew) and 30 g coconut chutney for dipping.
Reheat 200 g poha (flattened rice) in a skillet or microwave for 3–5 minutes until warm.
Top with 20 g roasted peanuts and serve with 1 lemon wedge.
Prepare 200 g upma (semolina) in a skillet with 50 g mixed vegetables for 12 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with 30 g coconut chutney on the side.
Place 200 g curd (dahi) in a bowl.
Top with 1 sliced banana.
Boil 150 g potato until tender, about 10 minutes, then peel and cube.
Cook 150 g white rice.
Plate together: boiled potato, rice, and 1 peeled banana.
Arrange 3 idli on a plate and serve with 30 g peanut chutney for dipping.
Add 1 banana on the side.
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter on 2 slices bread.
Top with 1 sliced banana.
Place 1 peeled banana in a bowl.
Add 150 g plain yogurt.
Cook or warm 2 pieces roti (whole wheat flatbread).
Serve alongside 150 g curd (dahi).
Reheat 150 g poha (flattened rice) in a skillet for 3–5 minutes.
Serve with 150 g curd (dahi) on the side.
Heat 300 g rice congee in a pot until warm.
Transfer to a bowl, make a well in the center, and slide 1 soft egg into the well.
Top with 1 tbsp chopped scallions.
Heat 300 g rice congee in a pot until warm.
Warm 100 g pork mince in a skillet with seasonings.
Transfer congee to a bowl, top with the warm pork and 1 halved preserved (century) duck egg.
Pour 300 ml hot soy milk into a bowl or cup.
Serve with 1 youtiao (fried dough stick).
Boil 1 egg for 10 minutes until hard-boiled, then peel.
Pour 300 ml hot soy milk into a cup and place 1 youtiao (fried dough stick) in it.
Serve with the boiled egg on the side.
Heat 300 g rice congee in a pot.
Transfer to a bowl and top with 40 g Chinese pickles.
Heat 300 g rice congee in a pot until warm.
Chop 1 century egg and 60 g shredded pork, mix into the hot congee, and stir well.
Heat 1 mantou (steamed bun) in a steamer or microwave for 1–2 minutes.
Serve with 300 ml hot soy milk on the side.
Fry 120 g beef tapa (marinated beef) in a skillet over medium heat until warmed through.
Prepare 200 g sinangag (garlic fried rice) by heating it in a skillet.
Fry 1 egg in a skillet.
Plate together: tapa, garlic fried rice, and fried egg.
Heat 200 g sinangag (garlic fried rice) in a skillet.
Fry 1 egg in a separate skillet.
Fry 60 g danggit (dried fish) in the skillet until heated through.
Plate together: garlic fried rice, fried egg, and dried fish.
Fry 80 g Spam (canned meat) slices in a skillet until browned.
Heat 200 g sinangag (garlic fried rice) in a skillet.
Fry 1 egg in a skillet.
Plate together: Spam, garlic fried rice, and fried egg.
Heat 200 g sinangag (garlic fried rice) in a skillet.
Fry 1 egg in a separate skillet.
Plate together: garlic fried rice, fried egg, and 50 g sliced tomato.
Fry 100 g longganisa in a skillet until cooked through.
Heat 200 g sinangag (garlic fried rice) in a skillet.
Fry 1 egg in a separate skillet.
Plate together: longganisa, garlic fried rice, fried egg, and 30 g atchara (pickled papaya).
Heat 300 ml beef broth soup in a pot.
Cook 150 g rice.
Add the rice to the soup, top with 50 g kimchi, and serve hot.
Cook 200 g rice.
Sauté 80 g mixed vegetables in a skillet until tender.
Plate rice, top with sautéed vegetables and 50 g kimchi, and serve with 1 cup hot tea on the side.
Prepare 300 ml kongnamul-gukbap (soybean sprout soup) by heating in a pot.
Cook 150 g rice.
Add rice to the hot soup and stir, optionally top with 1 scrambled or soft-cooked egg.
Mix 60 g rolled oats, 150 ml milk, and a pinch of salt in a mason jar.
Cover and refrigerate overnight, then top with 80 g mixed berries in the morning and stir before serving.
Heat 200 g cooked rice in a pot until warm.
Transfer to a bowl and serve with 150 g soy yoghurt on the side.
Mix 60 g overnight oats with a small amount of milk if needed.
Heat 250 g soy milk porridge in a pot until warm and layer with the overnight oats in a bowl.
Cook 60 g porridge oats in water or milk for 8 minutes until thick.
Transfer to a bowl, top with 1 sliced banana and 1 tbsp honey.
Toast 2 slices rustic bread until golden.
Grate 1 tomato and combine with 1 tbsp olive oil, then spread on the toast and top with 40 g jamón serrano.
Toast 2 slices rustic bread until golden.
Rub 1 clove garlic on the warm toast, then top with 80 g grated tomato and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Slice 1 baguette or roll.
Arrange on a plate with 30 g sliced cheese and 40 g sliced ham.
Pour 150 g yogurt into a bowl.
Top with 50 g muesli and 80 g mixed berries.
Cook a 2-egg omelette in a skillet until set, about 2 minutes per side.
Toast 1 slice bread and plate with the omelette and 100 g fresh fruit on the side.
Cook 60 g oatmeal in water or milk for 8 minutes until thick.
Transfer to a bowl, top with 1 sliced banana and 1 tbsp honey.
Toast 1 bagel and spread 1 tbsp peanut butter on each half.
Top with 1 sliced banana and drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Toast 2 slices white bread until golden.
Spread 1 tbsp jam on the toast and serve with 1 peeled banana on the side.
Toast 1 bagel.
Spread 1.5 tbsp peanut butter on each half.
Prepare 60 g instant oatmeal with hot water and stir in 1 tbsp brown sugar.
Boil 1 egg for 12 minutes until hard-boiled, peel, and serve on top of the oatmeal.
Toast 2 slices bread until golden and drizzle with 1 tbsp maple syrup.
Serve with 1 peeled banana on the side.
Pour 60 g cornflakes cereal into a bowl and add milk.
Stir in 1 tbsp peanut butter, top with 100 g applesauce and 1–2 sliced bananas.
Cook 60 g oatmeal in water or milk for 8 minutes until thick.
Stir in 1 tbsp maple syrup and top with 1 serving meal-replacement drink (e.g., Ensure).
Spread 1 tbsp peanut butter on 2 slices bread.
Top with 1 sliced banana and drizzle with 1 tsp honey.
Reheat 200 g cooked pasta and 150 g meat sauce together in a pot until hot.
Plate and serve.
Cook a 2-egg omelette in a skillet until set.
Prepare 60 g plain oatmeal with water or milk, then plate with the omelette and 100 g fresh fruit.
Boil 100 g potato until tender, peel, cube, and toast 1 slice bread.
Cook 100 g white rice and plate together: boiled potato, rice, toast, and 1 peeled banana.
Toast 1/2 bagel.
Serve with 1 peeled banana on the side.
Toast 2 slices bread and spread 1 tbsp peanut butter on the toast.
Serve with 1 peeled banana on the side.
Drizzle 3 rice cakes with 1 tbsp honey.
Serve immediately.
Grill 180 g salmon fillet until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Cook 200 g quinoa according to package directions until fluffy.
Steam 120 g asparagus for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Plate together: salmon, quinoa, asparagus, and 60 g spinach salad dressed lightly with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Pan-sear 200 g firm tofu in a hot skillet with a little oil for 3–4 minutes per side until golden.
Cook 200 g quinoa according to package directions.
Steam 120 g asparagus for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Plate together: tofu, quinoa, asparagus, and 60 g spinach salad dressed with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Grill 180 g steak over high heat for 4–5 minutes per side until desired doneness.
Cook 200 g quinoa according to package directions.
Steam 120 g asparagus for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Plate together: steak, quinoa, asparagus, and 60 g spinach salad dressed with 1 tbsp olive oil.
Grill or pan-sear 180 g steak and slice.
Cook 250 g white rice and heat 120 g black beans.
Plate: rice, black beans, sliced steak, top with 2 tbsp guacamole, and serve 2 tbsp salsa on the side.
Shred 180 g rotisserie chicken.
Chop 150 g romaine lettuce and arrange in a bowl or on a plate.
Top with shredded chicken, 30 g corn tortilla strips, 30 g shredded cheese, and serve with 3 tbsp salsa.
Pan-sear 180 g beef in a hot skillet for 4–5 minutes until browned.
Roast 220 g sweet potato at 400°F for 20 minutes until tender.
Steam 120 g broccoli for 4–5 minutes until tender-crisp.
Plate together: beef, sweet potato, and broccoli.
Grill 180 g chicken breast until cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Cook 220 g brown rice according to package directions.
Sauté 120 g green beans in a skillet with a little oil for 5–7 minutes until tender.
Plate together: grilled chicken, brown rice, and sautéed green beans.
